result: The Bank of Canada RAISED its policy rate by 0.25 percentage points to 2.50% (a hike, not a hold).
The FOMC kept the federal funds target range at 3.75% to 4.00% in a 10-2 vote; Lisa D. Cook and Beth M. Hammack dissented in favour of a 0.25-point increase.

event: Microsoft fiscal Q1 2027 earnings (quarter to Sep 30)
result: Revenue was $92.3 billion (up 19%), non-GAAP diluted EPS $4.89 (GAAP $4.92), Azure revenue grew 48% and Microsoft Cloud revenue was $63.9 billion (up 30%).
